title: Side Eye
blurb: A sting of pure silent judgement, and considerably more restrained than its bombastic cousin. This is the glance you give across a room when somebody says something questionable and you have decided to save the actual comment for the car journey home. Nothing is said, nothing needs to be, and everybody who caught it knows exactly what happened. Play it whenever a look would communicate more than a sentence — which, in most conversations, is more often than anyone would like to admit. Subtle, cutting, and entirely deniable if challenged.
origin: The audio sting of a judgmental sideways glance.
